SELECT EVENT_ID, TITLE, START_DATE, END_DATE, IMAGE_URL, IS_VISIBLE, IS_ENDED, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, DISPLAY_ORDER, WINNER_COUNT, RESULT_STATUS, RESULT_ANNOUNCED_AT, PARTICIPATION_COUNT FROM ( SELECT E.EVENT_ID, E.TITLE, E.START_DATE, E.END_DATE, E.IMAGE_URL, E.IS_VISIBLE, E.IS_ENDED, E.CREATED_BY, E.CREATED_AT, E.DISPLAY_ORDER, E.WINNER_COUNT, E.RESULT_STATUS, E.RESULT_ANNOUNCED_AT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EVENT_PARTICIPATION EP WHERE EP.EVENT_ID = E.EVENT_ID ) AS PARTICIPATION_COUNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY E.CREATED_AT DESC) AS ROW_NUM FROM EVENT E
) WHERE ROW_NUM > #{skip} AND ROW_NUM <= #{endRow} ORDER BY ROW_NUM

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "totalCount", NVL(SUM( CASE WHEN E.IS_VISIBLE = 'Y' AND E.IS_ENDED = 'N' AND NVL(E.RESULT_STATUS, 'PENDING') = 'PENDING' AND SYSDATE >= E.START_DATE AND SYSDATE < E.END_DATE + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS "visibleCount", NVL(SUM( CASE WHEN E.IS_ENDED = 'N' AND NVL(E.RESULT_STATUS, 'PENDING') = 'PENDING' AND SYSDATE >= E.START_DATE AND SYSDATE < E.END_DATE + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS "ongoingCount", NVL(SUM( CASE WHEN NVL(E.RESULT_STATUS, 'PENDING') = 'PENDING' AND ( E.IS_ENDED = 'Y' OR SYSDATE >= E.END_DATE + 1 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM EVENT_PARTICIPATION EP WHERE EP.EVENT_ID = E.EVENT_ID ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS "drawCount" FROM EVENT E

SELECT EVENT_ID, TITLE, START_DATE, END_DATE, IMAGE_URL, IS_VISIBLE, IS_ENDED, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, DISPLAY_ORDER, WINNER_COUNT, RESULT_STATUS, RESULT_ANNOUNCED_AT, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EVENT_PARTICIPATION WHERE EVENT_PARTICIPATION.EVENT_ID = EVENT.EVENT_ID ) AS PARTICIPATION_COUNT FROM EVENT ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT EVENT_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, START_DATE, END_DATE, IMAGE_URL, IS_VISIBLE, IS_ENDED, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, DISPLAY_ORDER, WINNER_COUNT, RESULT_STATUS, RESULT_ANNOUNCED_AT FROM EVENT WHERE EVENT_ID = #{event_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EVENT ( TITLE, CONTENT, START_DATE, END_DATE, IMAGE_URL, IS_VISIBLE, IS_ENDED, CREATED_BY, DISPLAY_ORDER, WINNER_COUNT ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{content}, #{start_date}, #{end_date}, #{image_url}, NVL(#{is_visible}, 'Y'), NVL(#{is_ended}, 'N'), #{created_by}, #{display_order}, #{winner_count} )
mapper.update:
UPDATE EVENT
TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, START_DATE = #{start_date}, END_DATE = #{end_date}, IS_VISIBLE = #{is_visible}, DISPLAY_ORDER = #{display_order}, WINNER_COUNT = #{winner_count},
IMAGE_URL = #{image_url},
WHERE EVENT_ID = #{event_id}
UPDATE EVENT SET IS_VISIBLE = 'Y' WHERE EVENT_ID = #{event_id} AND IS_ENDED = 'N' AND NVL(RESULT_STATUS, 'PENDING') = 'PENDING' AND SYSDATE < END_DATE + 1
UPDATE EVENT SET IS_VISIBLE = 'N', IS_ENDED = 'Y' WHERE EVENT_ID = #{event_id}
mapper.select: SELECT EVENT_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, START_DATE, END_DATE, IMAGE_URL, DISPLAY_ORDER FROM EVENT WHERE IS_VISIBLE = 'Y' AND IS_ENDED = 'N' AND SYSDATE >= START_DATE AND SYSDATE < END_DATE + 1 ORDER BY DISPLAY_ORDER ASC, CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT EP.PARTICIPATION_ID, EP.EVENT_ID, EP.MEMBER_ID, EP.PARTICIPATED_AT, EP.RESULT_STATUS, E.TITLE, M.NAME, M.LOGIN_ID, M.EMAIL FROM EVENT_PARTICIPATION EP JOIN EVENT E ON EP.EVENT_ID = E.EVENT_ID JOIN MEMBER M ON EP.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID WHERE EP.EVENT_ID = #{event_id} ORDER BY EP.PARTICIPATED_AT DESC

SELECT ep.PARTICIPATION_ID, ep.EVENT_ID, ep.MEMBER_ID, ep.PARTICIPATED_AT, ep.RESULT_STATUS, e.TITLE, e.IMAGE_URL, e.START_DATE, e.END_DATE FROM EVENT_PARTICIPATION ep JOIN EVENT e ON ep.EVENT_ID = e.EVENT_ID WHERE ep.MEMBER_ID = #{member_id} ORDER BY ep.PARTICIPATED_AT DESC

SELECT EVENT_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, START_DATE, END_DATE, IMAGE_URL, IS_VISIBLE, IS_ENDED, DISPLAY_ORDER, WINNER_COUNT, RESULT_STATUS, RESULT_ANNOUNCED_AT FROM EVENT WHERE EVENT_ID = #{event_id} AND IS_VISIBLE = 'Y' AND IS_ENDED = 'N' AND SYSDATE >= START_DATE AND SYSDATE < END_DATE + 1

SELECT EVENT_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, START_DATE, END_DATE, IMAGE_URL, IS_VISIBLE, IS_ENDED, DISPLAY_ORDER, WINNER_COUNT, RESULT_STATUS, RESULT_ANNOUNCED_AT FROM EVENT WHERE EVENT_ID = #{event_id} AND RESULT_STATUS = 'PENDING' AND ( IS_ENDED = 'Y' OR SYSDATE >= END_DATE + 1 )

SELECT PARTICIPATION_ID, EVENT_ID, MEMBER_ID, PARTICIPATED_AT, RESULT_STATUS FROM ( SELECT PARTICIPATION_ID, EVENT_ID, MEMBER_ID, PARTICIPATED_AT, RESULT_STATUS FROM EVENT_PARTICIPATION WHERE EVENT_ID = #{event_id} AND RESULT_STATUS = 'APPLIED' ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{winner_count}
mapper.update: UPDATE EVENT_PARTICIPATION SET RESULT_STATUS = 'NOT_SELECTED' WHERE EVENT_ID = #{event_id} AND RESULT_STATUS = 'APPLIED'
